text_block_list.text: One day, more than halfway through summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyyy~â

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Mega glamorous!
Turbo is super sparkly☆

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Kyahaha, it's true!
Turbo's shooting beams from her eyes!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally!
This filter is hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go show Nature too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!
Tonight, card games with Ikuno and the gang, okay~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainy, wanna take a pic too?
I found a filter that matches the sea so well!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Break's already over?
Alrighty, roger that~

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, add that mention from earlier~.
Reply lightning-fast to the DM~...

During the camp, Daitaku Helios went through
her training, but she just couldn't seem to focus.
—What, is that all you've got?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Good evan-ing!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyy~ Stanceâ

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hot-Blooded Retort!

text_block_list.name: Helios & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Helios & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: No, no~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So, what do you mean by 'this kind of stuff'?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Helios, you're all fired up
to take me down, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I sensed a heated showdown brewing, so I came to check it out, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, total letdown.
I kinda thought you'd have a bit more backbone, ya know?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's got bones!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's not what that means, boss.

A thought strikes me. Running with Bamboo Memory
might give Daitaku Helios the spark she needs
and get her fired up.
choice_data_list: Then how about we actually run it?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Oho.
Now that's interesting!"

“—And that's how a showdown
between Daitaku Helios and Bamboo Memory
came to be held.”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: 1600m on turf, right-handed to match Kyoto Racecourse, and I'm on the inside... No problems here, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Okie-dokie-suisui~.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's with that laid-back attitude!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering...
ramen? Yakisoba? Grilled squid?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You're already thinking about what to eat after this!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...As a pal, guess it's up to me to teach 'em how tough racing really is.
And so, the race began, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Take this!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Helios, shouldn't you be busting out your moves!?
They're about to cross the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, aren't you a late-closer!?
Why are you leading the pack!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You're just too slow!!

Against Bamboo Memory's overwhelming strength,
Daitaku Helios was utterly helpless...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I straight-up got totally wrecked!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, seems like you finally get it.
Just so you know, though—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is nothing compared to what I'll bring to the main event.
You'll be facing an even more polished version of me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!?
Does that mean it'll just be a half-memory!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
......Wait, where are you polishing?!
I couldn't even tell for a second!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, if you're trying to beat me... you're gonna need to get way more fired up, or you're in big trouble, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait... uh, can Bamboo not win this?
Isn't she way too strong??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Wait... don't tell me...
I'm in major deep doo-doo!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gyaa!
I can't let the Young Mistress see me looking uncool!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainy-P!
Make me insanely strong, pleaseee!!
choice_data_list: Can you stay focused and keep going?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
I'll do my besht~!

Racing against Bamboo Memory seems to
have been the right choice.
Before this fire dies out...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Explosive power!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's, like, that thing, right?
The thing that lets you bring out your maximum power!

Specifically, it means increasing the maximum output your muscles can deliver...
It seems she gets the gist of it, at least.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case,
I know some great training!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: K!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, just like I showed ya earlier!
Match my moves, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yoo~☆
How's it going!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Guess we should go say hi!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy-ayy-ayyy☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ooh, Trainy, that's totally perfect!
choice_data_list: ...Wait, what kind of training is this!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Nice comeback!
"...Of course, after this, I made sure she got in a solid training session."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: “—Well then, I look forward to our match over 2000 meters.”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
1000?! Whoa,
talk about going way too hard☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: 'Sup!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaaaah...!
No waaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"No more, please!
Leave them alooone!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, drill sergeant mode!!
I won't be able to dance anymore~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a gentle man...?
That gap makes my heart flutter...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a gentle woman...?
That gap makes my heart flutter...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hyai!

Naturally, while taking care not to injure herself,
Daitaku Helios pushed herself past her limits and gave it her all.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: “—Well then, I look forward to our match over 2000 meters.”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
I look forward to working with you...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, having to face Daiichi Ruby...
The pressure is unreal...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine! Borrow some strength from the "Illustrious Clan," 
and come back having grown leaps and bounds!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...?
I lost... but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You were so close to catching up!
You're definitely improving!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for interrupting, but this is my stop.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Daiichi Ruby lost steam in the final stretch. Maybe the distance wasn't right for her... Well, not really my place to worry about it, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho is 2,000m. And the
Queen Elizabeth II Cup is 2,200m..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It was your first time at 2,400 meters;
did you find the distance tough in some places?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...However, there's no choice but to press forward.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The final crown of the Tiara route.
—I must place it upon my head, without fail.
